sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current official IRS-hosted Form 1099-MISC PDF is Rev. December 2026 and displays the form title, calendar-year and copy labels, payer and recipient blocks, TIN fields, FATCA checkbox, account-number field, Box 2 Royalties, Box 4 Federal income tax withheld, and Boxes 16 through 18 state information. Copy presentation differs, including the display of VOID on Copy A and Copy 1 but not in the same way on recipient copies.
